# imagy.app

> > A comprehensive suite of free, browser-based image tools for compression, conversion, cropping, resizing, and metadata analysis without software installation.

imagy.app offers a collection of lightweight, privacy-focused online utilities for common image manipulation tasks. All tools work directly in the browser and support modern formats including PNG, WebP, AVIF, JPEG, GIF, and RAW files, with batch processing capabilities for efficient workflow.

## Key Topics

- Image compression
- Format conversion
- Batch processing
- Browser-based tools
- PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF
- Image resizing
- Aspect ratio
- Metadata (EXIF)
- Crop and split
- Privacy-focused
- Free online tools
- Social media optimization
- GIF support
- RAW image support

## Core Image Tools

- [Image Compressor](https://imagy.app/image-compressor): Free online image compressor supporting JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF formats with batch processing.
- [Image Converter](https://imagy.app/image-converter): Free browser-based image format converter for JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP and more.
- [Image Resizer](https://imagy.app/image-resizer): Free online image resizer supporting JPG, PNG, TIFF, RAW with batch resize and custom dimensions.
- [Crop Image Online](https://imagy.app/crop-image-online): Free online image cropper with batch processing, aspect ratio, and animated GIF support.

## Image Optimization & Adjustment

- [Image Aspect Ratio Changer](https://imagy.app/image-aspect-ratio-changer): Free aspect ratio adjuster for JPEG, PNG, WebP with social media optimization presets.
- [Split Image](https://imagy.app/split-image): Free image splitter for vertical/horizontal cuts with Instagram tiles and grid support.
- [Aspect Ratio Calculator](https://imagy.app/aspect-ratio-calculator): Free aspect ratio calculator for images and videos with common presets (16:9, 1:1, 4:3).

## Image Analysis & Metadata

- [EXIF Data Viewer](https://imagy.app/exif-data-viewer): Free EXIF metadata viewer showing GPS location, camera settings, and image properties.
- [Image Size Finder](https://imagy.app/image-size-finder): Free image dimension and file size checker supporting JPG, PNG, TIFF, RAW formats.
